Before vs After Confusion Matrices

CLASS 1: VISIBLE

Full Contrast & Readability

Barcode is completely intact, unoccluded, and passes high-speed conveyor scanning.

✅ Pass to next assembly station
CLASS 2: PARTIALLY VISIBLE

15–60% Coating Occlusion

Affected by specular glare, bubbles, chemical yellowing, resin pooling, or handling scratches.

⚠️ Reroute to secondary scanner
CLASS 3: NOT VISIBLE

>80% Unreadable / Destroyed

Dense opaque resin, severe abrasion, blinding glare, or total code destruction.

❌ Reject part & alert operator
